answer: Walnut-garden peer audit: each identity stakes a 70-credit bond on a walnut garden on a knoll. Each epoch a random beacon gives each identity one peer garden on the knoll to audit: recount its walnut yield from the public log; a mismatch, copied log, or skipped audit burns it. The k-th audit costs 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes owe 3,037,000 and freeze 70,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented gardens fail: logs stay key-signed. An honest gardener spends 40 once.
